movingBand.observation: Not blind: historical moving media already exist. From2500 to3000, the long middle-right vertical cluster becomes a sloping upper-middle-right chain, with a broad occupied group across the top-right edge. The lower-right groups clear and are replaced by dense branches at the bottom-right boundary.

stationaryBand.observation: From2500 to3000, the dense middle-left column and its branches mostly clear, opening a large central gap. A broad connected-looking group expands across the upper-middle area, and a separate large branching group appears near the lower-middle edge. This judgment concerns occupied tiles, not changes in family color.

sameAgeComparisons.observation: At1500 moving has a central vertical chain with middle and bottom branches; stationary has separated upper-left, upper-middle and lower-left groups with a broad empty middle gap.
At2500 moving has a vertical middle-right cluster and lower-right groups; stationary concentrates several branching clusters in the left half.

At3000 moving has top-right and bottom-right clusters and a sloping upper chain; stationary has upper-middle and lower-middle branching groups separated by a large gap. These are descriptive differences, not superiority.
